desc: Ideate reduction to longest palindromic suffix and KMP-on-reverse approach
Implement the O(n) KMP solution in Python using bytes I/O: build LPS for reverse(S), stream S to get longest palindromic suffix length q, output S + reverse(S[:n-q])
Validate against brute force for all short strings over a tiny alphabet and check edge cases (n=1, already palindrome, q==n fallback)
Benchmark/memory assessment: O(n) time with ~500k simple loop iterations and ~18MB LPS list are well within typical limits; no array('i') switch needed
